verses.text: I want you to know how hard I am struggling for you, for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me in person.
I want their hearts to be encouraged and joined together in love. I want them to have the full riches of complete understanding. Then they will know God's secret, which is Christ himself.
All the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden in him.
I tell you this so that no one will fool you with clever-sounding talk.
Even though I am away from you in body, I am with you in spirit. I am glad to see how well you are doing and how firm your faith in Christ is.
So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, keep on living in him.
Be rooted and built up in him. Be strong in the faith, as you were taught, and overflow with thanks.
Make sure no one captures you with empty and false ideas. Such ideas come from human tradition and the basic powers of this world, not from Christ.
All the fullness of God lives in Christ in a human body.
And you have been given full life in Christ. He is the head over every power and authority.
In him you were also circumcised, but not by human hands. Your sinful nature was cut away, by the circumcision that Christ gives.
You were buried with him in baptism. And you were raised with him through your faith in the power of God, who raised him from the dead.
You were dead in your sins, and your sinful nature was not yet cut away. But God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our sins.
He cancelled the written record of what we owed, with its rules that were against us. He took it away and nailed it to the cross.
He took away the power of the rulers and authorities. He made a public show of them, and won the victory over them by the cross.
So do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or about a festival, a New Moon celebration or a Sabbath day.
These are a shadow of the things that were coming. The real thing is found in Christ.

Do not let anyone rob you of your prize. Some people delight in false humility and in worshipping angels. They go into great detail about what they have seen. Their sinful minds puff them up with empty pride.
They have lost touch with the head, Christ. From him the whole body is fed and held together by its joints and muscles. And it grows as God makes it grow.
You died with Christ to the basic powers of this world. So why do you still live as if you belonged to the world? Why do you follow its rules?
"Do not hold! Do not taste! Do not touch!"
These rules are about things that are all used up and gone. They are only human commands and teachings.
Such rules may seem wise, with their self-made worship, false humility and harsh treatment of the body. But they are no use at all in stopping the desires of the sinful nature.
